title: Ensure all aspects of the pipeline infrastructure and configuration are immutable
description: The Groovy sandbox is what stands between a pipeline script and the controller itself: outside it, a script runs with the controller's own privileges and can rewrite jobs, read every credential and alter the running instance — the opposite of an immutable pipeline infrastructure. This control checks the one aspect of immutability a job's configuration exposes; the broader question (is the controller deployed as code?) still needs a person.
remediation: Job -> Configure -> Pipeline: tick "Use Groovy Sandbox". If the script then needs signature approvals, grant the specific methods at Manage Jenkins -> In-process Script Approval rather than turning the sandbox back off — each approval is one named hole instead of no wall at all. Better still, move the script into SCM (see CIS-2.3.1), where the sandbox is on by default.
fixSummary: Tick "Use Groovy Sandbox" at the job's Configure -> Pipeline definition.
